units.source_text: 我思考着这种没有价值的事情时，一个人影从大门前的宽阔马路上朝这边走了过来。

en.t: As I was thinking about such worthless things,
came walking toward me from the broad road in front of the main gate.

units.source_text: 白天的游客早已走光，只有月光下的松树以及来往于电车道上的汽车的前灯闪光，占据了这一带的夜。

en.t: and only the pines in the moonlight and the flashes of headlights from cars passing along the streetcar road
occupied the night around that place.
